cc:Work.dc:description: Four source rows on a shared success axis: pass@1, GPT-5.6 Sol selection, and oracle pass@5. Solid segments show realized gains; dashed segments show remaining headroom. Selection labels show score and percentage-point gain over pass@1. All 66 tasks per source; homogeneous pools assume valid selection and unreviewed mixed pools use uniform fallback.
